head: bbb969dd85ebc988e93ab4aedbba195f2e2cc6fa
title: fix(auth): sign-up confirmation link tgp://verified lands on a confirmation screen (HUNT-01-124)
body:
HUNT-01-124 (agent 124) — links that leave the app and come back.

**B-HUNT01-1 — sign-up confirmation link opens the app to nothing.** A new member signs up with email, taps Confirm in the email on the same phone, and the app opens on whatever screen was last shown (Welcome after a cold start) with no word that the email was confirmed and no next step. The backend asks Supabase to return to `tgp://verified` (`src/auth/auth.service.ts` emailRedirectTo default), and the app's linking config had no `verified` route.

Fix (mobile only, T2: one new auth landing screen and one linking entry; no auth, token or session boundary change):
- `EmailVerified` route at linking path `verified` (`src/navigation/RootNavigator.tsx`, `src/navigation/AuthNavigator.tsx`).
- `emailVerifiedPath` (`src/navigation/deepLinkUtils.ts`) reduces `verified#access_token=...` to a token-free `status` before parsing, so session tokens never reach route params or navigation state. Supabase error returns (`error_code=otp_expired`, expired or already-used link) map to `status=link_problem`.
- `src/screens/auth/EmailVerifiedScreen.tsx`: "Email confirmed" plus Sign in (opens Login), or Continue when the sign-up screen is still open underneath, so "I verified my email" finishes with the password already typed. Link problem: own copy, Sign in and Contact support (existing pre-sign-in support route).
- Test: `src/navigation/__tests__/hunt01EmailVerifiedLink.test.tsx` (real Supabase URL shapes through `linking.getStateFromPath`, token stripping, reset-password unchanged, screen buttons, copy rules). Failing first at ca4e22bc (test only) in ci-lane run 37523600806.

Needs the owner's Supabase step (already requested 12:46): Authentication > URL Configuration > Redirect URLs must contain `tgp://verified`.

Not in scope here (report ops/reports/HUNT-01-124.md): web landing for a confirmation opened on a computer (backend PR), Google `tgp://auth/callback` allow-list check, package share link, billing portal return URL.

Size: ~373 changed lines (176 test). Files claimed by HUNT-02 (CreateAccountScreen, LoginScreen) are untouched.
